questions.prompt: Where do you usually get your books from?
questions.sampleA1:
I get books at shop.

The shop is near my house.
questions.sampleA2:
I usually get my books from the library.

It is free and I like to read many books.

But sometimes I buy books from a shop because I want to keep them.
questions.sampleB1:
I usually get my books from Amazon because it's very easy.

They have a lot of books and the prices are good.

However, sometimes I go to a bookstore in town.

I like to look at the books before I buy them and maybe find something new.
questions.sampleB2: To be honest, I get most of my books online these days — I tend to order them off Amazon because it's convenient and the prices are hard to beat. That said, I do like to pop into a local bookshop now and then, mainly because there's something nice about browsing the shelves and stumbling across a book I'd never have found otherwise.
questions.uzSampleA1:
Men kitoblarni do'kondan olaman.

Do'kon uyimning yaqinida joylashgan.
questions.uzSampleA2:
Men odatda kitoblarimni kutubxonadan olaman.

U bepul va men ko'p kitob o'qishni yaxshi ko'raman.

Lekin ba'zida men kitoblarni do'kondan sotib olaman, chunki ularni saqlab qolishni xohlayman.
questions.uzSampleB1:
Men odatda kitoblarimni Amazondan olaman, chunki bu juda oson.

Ularda juda ko'p kitoblar bor va narxlari yaxshi.

Biroq, ba'zida shahardagi kitob do'koniga boraman.

Men kitoblarni sotib olishdan oldin ko'rishni va balki yangi narsa topishni xohlayman.
questions.uzSampleB2:
Men asosan kitoblarimni Amazon va Bookshop.org kabi onlayn sotuvchilardan olaman.

Qulaylik va xilma-xillik beqiyos, ayniqsa akademik matnlar yoki kam uchraydigan janrlar uchun.

Biroq, men vaqti-vaqti bilan mahalliy kitob do'konlariga ham borishga harakat qilaman.

Jismoniy javonlarni ko'zdan kechirish va aks holda topa olmagan nomlarni kashf qilishda o'ziga xos tasodif bor.

Qolaversa, mustaqil biznesni qo'llab-quvvatlash muhimdek tuyuladi.

vocabulary.title: Q1 - Where do you usually get your books from?
idioms: put all one's eggs in one basket - "barcha tuxumlarni bir savatga solmoq (barcha pul yoki xavf-xatarni faqat bitta narsaga tikmoq)"
a bookworm - "kitob qurti (kitob o'qishni juda yaxshi ko'radigan odam)"
don't judge a book by its cover - "kitobni muqovasiga qarab baho berma (tashqi ko'rinish aldamchi bo'lishi mumkin)"
phrases: hidden gem - "yashirin gavhar (tasodifan topilgan noyob, qiziqarli asar)"
sentenceStarters: "I predominantly purchase my books from online retailers because…" - "Men asosan kitoblarimni onlayn chakana savdo do'konlaridan sotib olaman, chunki…"

"However, I occasionally visit independent bookshops. There's something magical about…" - "Biroq, men vaqti-vaqti bilan mustaqil kitob do'konlariga ham borib turaman. U yerda … ga oid qandaydir sehrli narsa bor."

questions.sampleAnswer:
I predominantly purchase my books from online retailers because they offer an extensive selection and remarkably fast delivery right to my doorstep. It's incredibly convenient to find niche titles that local stores might not carry.
However, I occasionally visit independent bookshops. There's something magical about browsing the shelves and finding a hidden gem. Plus, it feels good to support local businesses, ensuring I don't "put all my eggs in one basket."
questions.uzSampleAnswer:
Men asosan kitoblarimni onlayn sotuvchilardan sotib olaman, chunki ular keng tanlov va juda tez yetkazib berishni taklif qilishadi, to'g'ri uyimga. Mahalliy do'konlarda bo'lmasligi mumkin bo'lgan noyob nomlarni topish juda qulay.

Biroq, men vaqti-vaqti bilan mustaqil kitob do'konlariga boraman. Javonlarni ko'zdan kechirish va yashirin durdonani topishda qandaydir sehr bor. Qolaversa, mahalliy biznesni qo'llab-quvvatlash yaxshi tuyg'u beradi, shu bilan "barcha tuxumlarni bir savatga solib qo'ymayman".

questions.prompt: Do you think it is important to have a good relationship with your neighbours?
questions.sampleA1: Yes. My neighbours are nice. I say hello.
questions.sampleA2: Yes, I think it's important. My neighbours are good. We talk and they help me, and I help them too.
questions.sampleB1: Yes, I think it's important to have a good relationship with your neighbours. It makes life easier. For example, if you need help with something, they can help you. Also, it's nice to feel part of a community, so it's good to be friendly.
questions.sampleB2: Absolutely, I'd say it's really important. The thing is, you never know when you might need to count on them — whether it's keeping an eye on your house while you're away or lending you something in a pinch. Beyond that, being on good terms with the people next door just makes daily life more pleasant and gives you a real sense of belonging.
questions.uzSampleA1: Ha. Mening qo'shnilarim yaxshi. Men ularga salom aytaman.
questions.uzSampleA2: Ha, menimcha bu muhim. Mening qo'shnilarim yaxshi. Biz gaplashamiz va ular menga yordam berishadi, men ham ularga yordam beraman.
questions.uzSampleB1:
Ha, menimcha qo'shnilar bilan yaxshi munosabatda bo'lish muhim. Bu hayotni osonlashtiradi.
Masalan, agar sizga biror narsada yordam kerak bo'lsa, ular sizga yordam berishi mumkin. Shuningdek, o'zingizni jamiyatning bir qismi deb his qilish yaxshi, shuning uchun do'stona bo'lish yaxshi.
questions.uzSampleB2: Men, albatta, qo'shnilar bilan yaxshi munosabatlarni rivojlantirish muhim deb o'ylayman. Bu yanada ijobiy yashash muhitiga va kuchliroq jamoatchilik tuyg'usiga hissa qo'shadi. Bu, shuningdek, amaliy; qachon ularning yordamiga muhtoj bo'lishingizni bilmaysiz, bu pochta yig'ish kabi kichik narsa bo'ladimi yoki favqulodda vaziyat kabi muhimroq narsa bo'ladimi. Bundan tashqari, qo'shnilar bilan yaxshi munosabatda bo'lish nizolar va tushunmovchiliklarning oldini olishga yordam beradi.

vocabulary.title: Q2 - Do you think it is important to have a good relationship with your neighbours?
idioms: a near neighbor is better than a distant cousin - "uzoqdagi qarindoshdan yaqindagi qo'shni afzal"
lend a helping hand - "yordam qo'lini cho'zmoq"
good fences make good neighbors - "yaxshi to'siqlar yaxshi qo'shnilar yaratadi (shaxsiy hududni hurmat qilish muhimligi)"
sentenceStarters: "Yes, I firmly believe that cultivating a harmonious relationship with neighbors is…" - "Ha, men qo'shnilar bilan uyg'un munosabatlarni rivojlantirish … ekanligiga qat'iy ishonaman."

"Furthermore, you never know when an emergency might occur. Having neighbors who…" - "Bundan tashqari, qachon favqulodda vaziyat yuz berishini hech qachon bilmaysiz. … qila oladigan qo'shnilarga ega bo'lish juda dalda beruvchidir."

questions.sampleAnswer:
Yes, I firmly believe that cultivating a harmonious relationship with neighbors is absolutely essential. A friendly neighborhood creates a strong sense of community and ensures a safe, peaceful living environment for everyone involved.
Furthermore, you never know when an emergency might occur. Having neighbors who can lend a helping hand is incredibly reassuring. As the saying goes, "a near neighbor is better than a distant cousin."
questions.uzSampleAnswer:
Ha, men qo'shnilar bilan uyg'un munosabatlarni rivojlantirish juda muhim deb qat'iy ishonaman. Do'stona mahalla kuchli jamoatchilik tuyg'usini yaratadi va barcha ishtirokchilar uchun xavfsiz, tinch yashash muhitini ta'minlaydi.

Bundan tashqari, favqulodda vaziyat qachon yuz berishini hech qachon bilmaysiz. Yordam qo'lini cho'zadigan qo'shnilarning bo'lishi juda dalda beradi. Maqol aytganidek, "Uzoqdagi qarindoshdan yaqindagi qo'shni yaxshiroq".

questions.prompt: Who usually cooks in your family?
questions.sampleA2: My mother cooks. She makes dinner. I help sometimes, but she is better.
questions.sampleB1: Usually, my mother cooks in my family. She is very good at it. Sometimes I help her, especially on weekends. I think cooking together is fun. However, I am not as good as her.
questions.sampleB2: In our house, it's usually my mum who does the cooking. She's a fantastic cook and she can whip up a proper meal in no time, even when the fridge is nearly empty. I do pitch in at weekends — mostly chopping vegetables or washing up — but my dishes don't quite measure up to hers. I suppose cooking is just her thing.
questions.uzSampleA2: Odatda onam ovqat qiladi. U kechki ovqat tayyorlaydi. Men ba'zida yordam beraman, lekin u yaxshiroq qiladi.
questions.uzSampleB1: Odatda, oilamda onam ovqat pishiradi. U bu ishni juda yaxshi uddalaydi. Ba'zan men unga yordam beraman, ayniqsa dam olish kunlarida. Menimcha, birgalikda ovqat pishirish qiziqarli. Biroq, men u kabi yaxshi emasman.
questions.uzSampleB2: Mening oilamda, odatda ovqatni onam tayyorlaydi. U juda mahoratli va yangi retseptlar bilan tajriba o'tkazishni yaxshi ko'radi. Men vaqti-vaqti bilan yordam berishga harakat qilaman, lekin tan olishim kerakki, uning taomlari odatda meniki bilan solishtirganda ancha ta'sirchan. O'ylashimcha, bu tajriba va oshpazlik san'atiga bo'lgan chinakam ishtiyoqning kombinatsiyasi.

vocabulary.title: Q3 - Who usually cooks in your family?
idioms: many hands make light work - "ko'pchilik qilingan mehnatning yuki yengil bo'ladi (ko'plashib qilingan ish oson bitadi)"
cook up a storm - "ajoyib bayramona(katta miqdorda) ovqat pishirmoq"
too many cooks spoil the broth - "ko'p oshpazli joyda ovqat kuydiriladi (bir xil qozonga hamma aralashaversa ish buziladi)"
sentenceStarters: "In my household, the cooking duties are primarily handled by…" - "Bizning uyda pishirib-kuydirish ishlari asosan … tomonidan bajariladi."
"However, on weekends, my father and I often proactively attempt to…" - "Biroq, dam olish kunlari men va dadam tez-tez yordam berishga … harakat qilamiz."

questions.sampleAnswer:
In my household, the cooking duties are primarily handled by my mother. She is an exceptionally talented cook who intuitively knows how to blend spices perfectly. It's truly her culinary domain, and she takes great pride in preparing nutritious meals.
However, on weekends, my father and I often proactively attempt to help out. While we might lack her finesse, sharing the responsibility is a great way to bond, demonstrating that "many hands make light work."
questions.uzSampleAnswer:
Mening uyimda, ovqat pishirish vazifalari asosan onam tomonidan bajariladi. U juda iste'dodli oshpaz, ziravorlarni qanday qilib mukammal aralashtirishni ichki sezgi bilan biladi. Bu haqiqatan ham uning oshxona sohasidir va u to'yimli ovqatlarni tayyorlashdan katta faxrlanadi.

Ammo, dam olish kunlari, otam va men ko'pincha yordam berishga faol harakat qilamiz. Bizda uning mahorati yetishmasligi mumkin bo'lsa-da, mas'uliyatni bo'lishish - bu yaqinlashishning ajoyib usuli, bu "ko'p qo'llar ishni yengillashtiradi" degan maqolni isbotlaydi.

questions.prompt: What activities are the children doing in each picture?
questions.sampleA1: Picture one, kids play game. Picture two, kids ride bike.
questions.sampleA2: In the first picture, the children are playing a game. They are inside. And in the second picture, the children are riding bikes. They are outside and it's sunny. I think they are happy.
questions.sampleB1: In the first picture, it looks like the children are playing a board game together. They're inside, so maybe it's raining outside. In the second picture, the children are riding their bikes in a park. It seems like they are having fun and getting exercise. It's a nice day for cycling.
questions.sampleB2:
The first picture clearly shows two young children, a boy and a girl, sitting opposite each other at a small table indoors. They are deeply engrossed in a board game, likely checkers, with wooden pieces. The setting appears to be a home interior, possibly a hallway, with a staircase and a large window.

In stark contrast, the second image depicts a vibrant outdoor scene. A group of six children, all wearing helmets, are happily riding their bikes along a winding path in a sunny park. They are smiling and having a great time. So, while both pictures feature children engaged in leisure, one highlights a quiet, indoor, focused activity, whereas the other illustrates an energetic, outdoor, group pursuit.
questions.uzSampleA1: Birinchi rasmda bolalar o'yin o'ynayapti. Ikkinchi rasmda bolalar velosiped haydayapti.
questions.uzSampleA2: Birinchi rasmda bolalar o'yin o'ynashyapti. Ular ichkarida. Va ikkinchi rasmda bolalar velosiped haydashyapti. Ular tashqarida va quyoshli. Menimcha, ular xursand.
questions.uzSampleB1: Birinchi rasmda, bolalar birgalikda stol o'yini o'ynayotganga o'xshaydi. Ular ichkarida, shuning uchun tashqarida yomg'ir yog'ayotgan bo'lishi mumkin. Ikkinchi rasmda, bolalar parkda velosipedda uchishmoqda. Ular xursandchilik qilishayotgan va mashq qilishayotganga o'xshaydi. Velosipedda uchish uchun yaxshi kun.
questions.uzSampleB2:
Birinchi rasmda ikki bola stol usti o'yiniga berilib ketganini ko'rish mumkin. Ular yopiq joyda ekanligini hisobga olsak, menimcha, ular noqulay ob-havo tufayli ko'proq harakatsiz va aqliy faoliyatni talab qiladigan mashg'ulot izlashmoqda.
Aksincha, ikkinchi rasmda bir guruh bolalar parkda velosipedda faol ravishda sayr qilishmoqda. Bu ularning ochiq havoda dam olishni va jismoniy faollikni afzal ko'rishlarini, yaxshi ob-havodan foydalanishlarini ko'rsatadi. Bu farq dam olish vaqtiga turlicha yondashuvlarni ta'kidlaydi.

vocabulary.title: Q4 - Describe the pictures
idioms: let off steam - "kuchli energiya(asabiylik)dan xalos bo'lmoq (o'ynab yengil tortmoq)"
a breath of fresh air - "toza havodan olingan nafasdek (ko'ngilni ko'taradigan farqli o'zgarish)"
play one's cards right - "vaziyatdan unumli(aqlli) foydalanmoq (garchi stol o'yinlaridan kelib chiqqan bo'lsa ham hayotda ishlatiladi)"
sentenceStarters: "The first picture depicts two children engaged in a quiet, indoor activity—they are…" - "Birinchi rasmda tinch, uy ichidagi mashg'ulot bilan band bo'lgan ikki bola tasvirlangan — ular…"
"Conversely, the second picture is bursting with energy. It illustrates…" - "Aksincha, ikkinchi rasm energiya bilan to'lib-toshgan. Unda … tasvirlangan."

questions.sampleAnswer:
The first picture depicts two children engaged in a quiet, indoor activity—they are focused intently on playing a board game together. The setting is cozy, suggesting a calculated, mental pursuit rather than physical exertion.
Conversely, the second picture is bursting with energy. It illustrates a group of children riding bicycles outdoors in a sunlit park. This scene is characterized by vigorous physical movement, fresh air, and a much more dynamic social interaction compared to the serene environment of the first image.
questions.uzSampleAnswer:
Birinchi rasmda ikki bola sokin, yopiq xonadagi mashg'ulot bilan band - ular birgalikda stol o'yinini o'ynashga diqqat bilan e'tibor qaratgan. Muhit shinam, jismoniy zo'riqishdan ko'ra, hisob-kitob qilingan, aqliy mashg'ulotni taklif qiladi.

Aksincha, ikkinchi rasm energiyaga to'la. Unda bir guruh bolalar quyosh nuri tushgan parkda velosipedda sayr qilayotgani tasvirlangan. Bu sahna jadal jismoniy harakat, toza havo va birinchi rasmdagi sokin muhitga nisbatan ancha dinamik ijtimoiy munosabatlar bilan ajralib turadi.

questions.prompt: How can outdoor physical activities help children grow compared to indoor games?
questions.sampleA1: I like outside. I play. It is good.
questions.sampleA2: I like to play outside. I can run and jump. It is fun and good for my body. But sometimes it is cold, so I play inside too.
questions.sampleB1: I think playing outside is better for children than playing inside. For example, they can run and play sports. Also, they get fresh air and sunshine. In my opinion, it's healthier than just sitting inside all day. However, indoor games are also good sometimes.
questions.sampleB2: To my mind, playing outside does wonders for kids in ways that indoor games simply can't match. Running around and cycling helps them build up their strength and motor skills, and the fresh air is great for their health. Plus, outdoor play teaches them to get along with others and let off steam. Indoor games are fine, but they can't make up for real exercise.
questions.uzSampleA1: Menga tashqari yoqadi. Men o'ynayman. Bu yaxshi.
questions.uzSampleA2: Men tashqarida o'ynashni yaxshi ko'raman. Men yugurishim va sakrashim mumkin. Bu qiziqarli va tanam uchun foydali. Lekin ba'zida sovuq bo'ladi, shuning uchun men ichkarida ham o'ynayman.
questions.uzSampleB1:
Menimcha, tashqarida o'ynash bolalar uchun ichkarida o'ynashdan yaxshiroq.
Masalan, ular yugurib sport o'yinlari bilan shug'ullanishlari mumkin. Shuningdek, ular toza havo va quyosh nuridan bahramand bo'lishadi.
Menimcha, bu kun bo'yi faqat ichkarida o'tirishdan ko'ra sog'lomroq.
Biroq, ba'zida uy o'yinlari ham yaxshi.
questions.uzSampleB2: Ochiq havoda mashg'ulotlar bolalarga yopiq o'yinlarga nisbatan rivojlanishga juda katta yordam berishi mumkin. Masalan, yugurish va sport bilan shug'ullanish ularning jismoniy salomatligi va muvofiqligini yaxshilaydi. Ular, shuningdek, tabiat va toza havoni his qilishadi, bu ularning farovonligi uchun muhimdir. Yopiq o'yinlar aqliy rivojlanish uchun yaxshi bo'lishi mumkin bo'lsa-da, tashqarida bo'lishning jismoniy foydalari inkor etib bo'lmaydi. Bu ularga doimo uyda qolishga nisbatan kuchli suyaklar va mushaklar qurishga yordam beradi.

vocabulary.title: Q5 - Outdoor physical activities vs indoor games
idioms: fit as a fiddle - "sppa-sog', tep-tetik (xuddi skripkadek soz)"
let off steam - "ortiqcha energiyani sarflamaslik/chiqarib yubormoq"
run wild - "erkin (ijozat berilgan tarzda) yugurib o'ynamoq (qoidasiz o'ynamoq)"
sentenceStarters: "Outdoor physical activities offer numerous developmental benefits that simply cannot be…" - "Tashqaridagi jismoniy harakatlar (o'yinlar) oddiygina … qilib bo'lmaydigan ko'plab rivojlanish afzalliklarini taqdim etadi."

"Furthermore, outdoor play exposes children to unpredictable environments, which helps them…" - "Bundan tashqari, ochiq havoda o'ynash bolalarni oldindan aytib bo'lmaydigan muhitlarga duchor qiladi va bu ularga … ga yordam beradi."

questions.sampleAnswer:
Outdoor physical activities offer numerous developmental benefits that simply cannot be replicated indoors. Primarily, running, jumping, and cycling are crucial for building motor skills and robust cardiovascular health. Children naturally burn off excess energy outside, which helps prevent childhood obesity.
Furthermore, outdoor play exposes children to unpredictable environments. Navigating a park or coordinating team games helps them develop spatial awareness, resilience, and complex problem-solving abilities when negotiating rules.
While indoor board games are excellent for strategic thinking, the sheer physical exertion and exposure to sunlight found outdoors undoubtedly help children grow up "fit as a fiddle."
questions.uzSampleAnswer:
Ochiq havoda jismoniy faolliklar ko'plab rivojlanish afzalliklarini taqdim etadi, ularni yopiq joylarda takrorlashning imkoni yo'q. Asosan, yugurish, sakrash va velosiped haydash motorika ko'nikmalarini va mustahkam yurak-qon tomir salomatligini shakllantirish uchun juda muhimdir. Bolalar tashqarida ortiqcha energiyani tabiiy ravishda yo'qotadilar, bu esa bolalikdagi semizlikning oldini olishga yordam beradi.

Bundan tashqari, ochiq havoda o'yin bolalarni oldindan aytib bo'lmaydigan muhitlarga duchor qiladi. Parkda harakatlanish yoki jamoaviy o'yinlarni muvofiqlashtirish ularga fazoviy xabardorlikni, chidamlilikni va qoidalarni kelishishda murakkab muammolarni hal qilish qobiliyatini rivojlantirishga yordam beradi.

Yopiq o'yin xonalardagi stol o'yinlari strategik fikrlash uchun ajoyib bo'lsa-da, tashqarida topiladigan jismoniy zo'riqish va quyosh nuriga ta'sir qilish bolalarning "chinni kabi sog'lom" bo'lib o'sishiga shubhasiz yordam beradi.

questions.prompt: Why might some children choose indoor games over outdoor activities?
questions.sampleA1: I like games in house. Outside is hot. I play game with my sister.
questions.sampleA2: Maybe some kids like games in the house because it's easy. And maybe outside is too hot or too cold. They can play video games, and that is fun too.
questions.sampleB1: Well, I think some children prefer indoor games because they are more comfortable. For example, they can play video games or board games in their house. Also, maybe the weather is bad outside, so they can't play. In my opinion, it depends on the child.
questions.sampleB2: Well, there are a few reasons, I suppose. For one thing, some kids are just homebodies — they feel more at ease indoors, especially if they're a bit shy. The weather plays a part too; when it's pouring down, staying in and playing a board game is far more appealing. And let's face it, video games and screens are incredibly hard to resist these days.
questions.uzSampleA1: Men uy ichidagi o'yinlarni yaxshi ko'raman. Tashqarida issiq. Men singlim bilan o'ynayman.
questions.uzSampleA2: Balki ba'zi bolalarga uy ichidagi o'yinlar yoqishi mumkin, chunki bu oson. Va balki tashqarida juda issiq yoki juda sovuqdir. Ular video o'yinlar o'ynashlari mumkin va bu ham qiziqarli.
questions.uzSampleB1:
Xo'sh, menimcha, ba'zi bolalar yopiq o'yinlarni afzal ko'rishadi, chunki ular qulayroq.
Masalan, ular uyida video o'yinlar yoki stol o'yinlarini o'ynashlari mumkin. Shuningdek, ehtimol, tashqarida ob-havo yomon, shuning uchun ular o'ynay olmaydi.
Mening fikrimcha, bu bolaga bog'liq.
questions.uzSampleB2: Bolaning ochiq havoda o'yin-kulgi o'rniga yopiq o'yinlarni tanlashiga bir nechta sabab bo'lishi mumkin. Ehtimol, ular xavfsiz ochiq joylarga kirish imkoniyati cheklangan hududda yashashlari mumkin, bu esa yopiq o'yinlarni yanada jozibali variantga aylantiradi. Shuningdek, ba'zi bolalar shunchaki yopiq o'yinlarning tuzilgan muhiti va oldindan aytib bo'ladigan qoidalarini afzal ko'rishlari, ochiq havoda o'yin-kulgilarni juda tartibsiz yoki haddan tashqari deb bilishlari mumkin. Bundan tashqari, raqamli o'yin-kulgi keng tarqalgani juda qiziqarli bo'lishi mumkin bo'lgan turli xil yopiq variantlarni taklif etadi.

vocabulary.title: Q6 - Indoor games vs outdoor activities
idioms: make do with what you have - "boriga rozi(qanoat) qilmoq"
a creature of habit - "odatlanib qolgan odam (odatlariga sodiq bolalar)"
in one's element - "o'zining odatiy (eng qulay) muhitida bo'lmoq"
sentenceStarters: "Some children naturally gravitate towards indoor games because they offer a…" - "Ba'zi bolalar tabiiy ravishda uy o'yinlariga moyillik bildiradilar, chunki ular … muhitni taqdim etadi."

"Additionally, some introverted children simply find loud, chaotic outdoor settings…" - "Qo'shimchasiga, ba'zi tuman-tarqoq(introvert) bolalar shunchaki baland, tartibsiz tashqi sharoitlarni … deb bilishadi."

questions.sampleAnswer:
Some children naturally gravitate towards indoor games because they offer a highly structured, emotionally safe environment. Unlike the unpredictable nature of an outdoor playground, a board game has explicit rules and clear turns, appealing to children who prefer logic and order.
Additionally, some introverted children simply find loud, chaotic outdoor settings overwhelming. They greatly prefer the quiet contemplation required for a puzzle or a video game, allowing them to recharge their mental batteries comfortably.
Lastly, inclement weather or a lack of safe parks in urban areas forces children inside. Under these circumstances, choosing indoor games is purely a matter of making the best out of a bad situation—they must "make do with what they have."
questions.uzSampleAnswer:
Ba'zi bolalar tabiiy ravishda yopiq o'yinlarga moyil bo'lishadi, chunki ular yuqori darajada tuzilgan, hissiy jihatdan xavfsiz muhitni taklif qilishadi. Ochiq havoda o'yin maydonchasining oldindan aytib bo'lmaydigan tabiatidan farqli o'laroq, stol o'yini aniq qoidalarga va aniq navbatlarga ega bo'lib, mantiq va tartibni afzal ko'radigan bolalarga yoqadi.

Bundan tashqari, ba'zi introvert bolalar shunchaki shovqinli, tartibsiz tashqi muhitni haddan tashqari og'ir deb bilishadi. Ular boshqotirma yoki video o'yin uchun zarur bo'lgan sokin mulohazani juda afzal ko'rishadi, bu ularga o'zlarining ruhiy batareyalarini qulay tarzda zaryad qilish imkonini beradi.

Nihoyat, noqulay ob-havo yoki shahar joylarida xavfsiz parklarning yo'qligi bolalarni ichkariga kirishga majbur qiladi. Bunday sharoitlarda yopiq o'yinlarni tanlash shunchaki yomon vaziyatdan eng yaxshi foydalanish masalasidir - ular "boriga baraka" deyishga majbur.

questions.prompt: Can you describe a place where people like exercising?
questions.sampleA1: Park. People run. I go park. It is good.
questions.sampleA2: I know a place. It is a park. People go there and they run and play football. It is good for exercise because it is big and has grass.
questions.sampleB1: Well, I think a popular place for exercise is the local gym. It has lots of equipment like treadmills and weights. People go there to get fit. Also, there are classes like Zumba, which are fun. However, it can be expensive.
questions.sampleB2: Right, well the place that immediately springs to mind is the big riverside park not far from where I live. It's got a long tarmac running track that winds along the water, plenty of open green space, and even a little outdoor gym with pull-up bars. Every morning it's absolutely buzzing with people — joggers, cyclists, folk doing yoga on the grass. To be honest, I think the scenery is a huge part of the appeal; the fresh air and the river view make the whole thing feel far less like a chore. It's the kind of spot that genuinely motivates you to keep at it, even on a cold morning. Now, why is physical activity so important? Well, the thing is, our bodies simply aren't built to sit around all day. Regular exercise wards off serious illnesses like heart disease and diabetes, and it does wonders for your mood too. Whenever I break a sweat, I genuinely feel my stress melt away — it's a brilliant way to clear your head after a long day. Beyond the physical benefits, staying active gives you a real sense of accomplishment and boosts your confidence no end. As for how communities can encourage active lifestyles, I suppose the key is making exercise easy and free. Councils should invest in well-lit paths, safe cycle lanes and public parks, so people don't have to fork out for an expensive gym. On top of that, organising things like weekend fun runs or free fitness classes really helps get people moving. At the end of the day, if it's convenient and sociable, most people will happily join in.

Uning jozibadorligi qulayligi va arzonligida bo'lib, uni barcha yoshdagi va jismoniy tayyorgarlik darajasidagi odamlar uchun mashhur tanlovga aylantiradi. Bundan tashqari, ijtimoiy jihat katta ahamiyatga ega, chunki odamlar do'stlar bilan uchrashishlari va guruh mashg'ulotlarida qatnashishlari mumkin, bu esa o'zlarining fitnes maqsadlariga erishish bilan birga jamoatchilik tuyg'usini shakllantiradi.

bulletPoints: Can you describe a place where people like exercising?
Why is physical activity important for health?
How can communities promote active lifestyles?
questions.sampleAnswer:
A place where people like exercising:
A highly popular exercise venue in my city is a newly renovated riverfront park. It features a miles-long rubberized running track, outdoor calisthenics equipment, and beautifully maintained grassy areas for yoga. Every morning, it is brimming with fitness enthusiasts. The scenic view and the refreshing breeze make the physical exertion feel markedly less strenuous, creating an incredibly motivating environment.
Why physical activity is important:
Physical activity is paramount because the human body was designed to move. A sedentary lifestyle acts as a silent killer, leading directly to obesity, heart disease, and diabetes. Conversely, regular exercise strengthens the immune system, regulates metabolism, and triggers the release of endorphins, acting as a potent antidote against anxiety and depression.
How communities can promote active lifestyles:
Communities can effectively promote active living by radically redesigning urban infrastructure. Local governments must invest heavily in accessible green spaces, properly lit jogging trails, and protected bicycle lanes. Furthermore, organizing inclusive community events, like weekend fun runs, encourages broad participation. When physical activity is safe, accessible, and social, the entire demographic will inevitably "get off the couch."
questions.uzSampleAnswer:
Odamlar mashq qilishni yaxshi ko'radigan joy:

Mening shahrimdagi juda mashhur mashq joyi - bu yaqinda ta'mirlangan daryo bo'yidagi park. Unda bir necha kilometrga cho'zilgan rezina yugurish yo'lagi, ochiq havoda kalistenika uskunalari va yoga uchun chiroyli saqlangan maysazorlar mavjud. Har kuni ertalab u fitnes ixlosmandlari bilan to'lib-toshgan. Manzarali ko'rinish va tetiklantiruvchi shabada jismoniy zo'riqishni ancha kam kuchliroq his qilishga yordam beradi va aql bovar qilmaydigan darajada motivatsiya beruvchi muhit yaratadi.

Nima uchun jismoniy faollik muhim:

Jismoniy faollik juda muhim, chunki inson tanasi harakat qilish uchun yaratilgan. Harakatsiz turmush tarzi semizlik, yurak kasalliklari va diabetga olib keladigan jim qotil vazifasini o'taydi. Aksincha, muntazam mashqlar immunitet tizimini mustahkamlaydi, metabolizmni tartibga soladi va endorfinlarning ajralishini tetiklaydi, bu esa xavotir va depressiyaga qarshi kuchli antidot vazifasini bajaradi.

Jamiyatlar qanday qilib faol turmush tarzini targ'ib qilishlari mumkin:

Jamiyatlar shahar infratuzilmasini tubdan qayta loyihalash orqali faol hayotni samarali targ'ib qilishlari mumkin. Mahalliy hukumatlar ochiq yashil hududlarga, yaxshi yoritilgan yugurish yo'laklariga va himoyalangan velosiped yo'laklariga katta sarmoya kiritishlari kerak. Bundan tashqari, dam olish kunlaridagi qiziqarli yugurishlar kabi inklyuziv jamoat tadbirlarini tashkil etish keng ishtirokni rag'batlantiradi. Jismoniy faollik xavfsiz, ochiq va ijtimoiy bo'lganda, butun demografik guruh inevitable tarzda "divandan turadi".

questions.sampleB2: Right, this is a real hot topic, and I can honestly see both sides of the argument. On the one hand, supporters would say that education is a basic right rather than a luxury, and no one should be priced out of a decent future. If you do away with tuition fees, then bright students from poorer families finally get a fair shot at university, regardless of their background. That would help level the playing field and, in the long run, produce a far more skilled workforce. On top of that, graduating without a mountain of debt would take a huge weight off young people's shoulders and let them stand on their own two feet much sooner. On the other hand, though, I do think the critics have a point. The thing is, someone has to foot the bill, and that usually means higher taxes for everyone. There's also a risk that if something is completely free, people start to take it for granted and don't work as hard. You only have to look at how casually people treat things they haven't paid for. And universities need a steady stream of funding to keep their research and teaching up to scratch. All things considered, though, I'd lean towards saying that education should at least be heavily subsidised, even if it can't be entirely free. To my mind, a middle-ground approach — like grants for those who genuinely need them — would strike a balance between fairness and what the country can actually afford. It's a tricky one, but investing in young people always pays off eventually.

questions.sampleAnswer:
The notion of providing universal, tuition-free higher education is highly controversial. Supporters passionately argue that education is a fundamental human right, not a privilege. By abolishing fees, society ensures strictly equal opportunities, allowing talented youth from impoverished backgrounds to achieve their career goals. Furthermore, removing crippling student debt severely reduces financial stress for families, ultimately creating a more highly skilled and economically competitive workforce.
Conversely, critics are deeply skeptical of the economic reality. They emphasize that governments simply cannot afford such astronomical expenses without enacting crippling tax hikes. Additionally, some fear that completely free education might ironically reduce student motivation; when a service costs nothing, people often take it for granted. Finally, universities require massive, continuous funding to maintain cutting-edge research facilities and pay top-tier professors.
In conclusion, while the ideal of free education is undoubtedly noble, its implementation is "easier said than done." A balanced approach—such as heavily subsidized logic or means-tested grants—is likely the most pragmatic solution.
questions.uzSampleAnswer:
Oliy taʼlimni bepul taʼminlash gʻoyasi juda bahsli. Tarafdorlar taʼlim huquq emas, balki imtiyoz ekanligini qizgʻin himoya qiladilar. Toʻlovlarni bekor qilish orqali jamiyat qatʼiy teng imkoniyatlarni taʼminlaydi, bu esa kambagʻal oilalardan chiqqan isteʼdodli yoshlarga oʻz karera maqsadlariga erishishga imkon beradi. Bundan tashqari, ogʻir talaba qarzlari oilalar uchun moliyaviy stressni sezilarli darajada kamaytiradi va oxir-oqibatda yanada malakali va iqtisodiy jihatdan raqobatbardosh ishchi kuchini yaratadi.

Aksincha, tanqidchilar iqtisodiy haqiqatga chuqur shubha bilan qarashadi. Ular hukumatlar shunchaki ogʻir soliq yukini oshirmasdan bunday astronomik xarajatlarni qoplay olmasligini taʼkidlaydilar. Bundan tashqari, baʼzilar bepul taʼlim talabalarning motivatsiyasini ironik tarzda kamaytirishi mumkinligidan xavotirda; xizmat hech narsa turmasa, odamlar koʻpincha uni oʻz-oʻzidan ravshan deb qabul qiladilar. Nihoyat, universitetlar eng zamonaviy tadqiqot inshootlarini saqlab qolish va yuqori darajadagi professorlarga pul toʻlash uchun katta, doimiy moliyalashtirishni talab qiladi.

Xulosa qilib aytganda, bepul taʼlim gʻoyasi, shubhasiz, olijanob boʻlsa-da, uni amalga oshirish "gapirishdan koʻra osonroq". Yaxshi muvozanatli yondashuv — masalan, ogʻir subsidiyalangan logika yoki mablagʻga qarab beriladigan grantlar — eng amaliy yechim boʻlishi mumkin.
